Okay I wanted a more neutral-looking character so I drew my side sona, replacing the male player sheet. I have no idea if I did it right but the preliminary results satisfy me.

[b][size=3]Installation:[/size][/b]
1) Back up all the files in Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer just in case
2) Take farmer_base.xnb and hairstyles.xnb from this mod and paste them in Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer (override)
